<output>
# dua (Disk Usage Analyzer)

**dua** is a tool to conveniently learn about the usage of disk space of a given directory. It's parallel by default and will max out your SSD, providing relevant information as fast as possible. Optionally delete superfluous data, and do so more quickly than `rm`.

[![asciicast](https://asciinema.org/a/kDnXUOeqBxZVMoWuFNqzfpeey.svg)](https://asciinema.org/a/kDnXUOeqBxZVMoWuFNqzfpeey)

## Installation

### Binary Release 

#### MacOS

```sh
curl -LSfs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Byron/dua-cli/master/ci/install.sh | \
    sh -s -- --git Byron/dua-cli --crate dua --tag v2.29.0
```

#### MacOS via [MacPorts](https://www.macports.org):
```sh
sudo port selfupdate
sudo port install dua-cli
```

#### MacOS via [Homebrew](https://brew.sh)
```sh
brew update
brew install dua-cli
```

#### Linux

Linux requires the target to be specified explicitly to obtain the MUSL build.

```sh
curl -LSfs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Byron/dua-cli/master/ci/install.sh | \
    sh -s -- --git Byron/dua-cli --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl --crate dua --tag v2.29.0
```

#### Windows via [Scoop](https://scoop.sh/)
```sh
scoop install dua
```

#### Windows via [WinGet](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/package-manager/winget/)
```sh
winget install Byron.dua-cli
```

#### Pre-built Binaries

See the [releases section](https://github.com/Byron/dua-cli/releases) for manual installation of a binary, pre-built for many platforms.

#### VoidLinux
Via `xbps` on your VoidLinux system.

```
xbps-install dua-cli
```

#### Fedora
Via `dnf` on your Fedora system.

```
sudo dnf install dua-cli
```

#### Arch Linux
Via `pacman` on your ArchLinux system.

```
sudo pacman -S dua-cli
```

#### NixOS
https://search.nixos.org/packages?channel=23.11&show=dua&from=0&size=50&sort=relevance&type=packages&query=dua

Nix-shell (temporary)

```
nix-shell -p dua
```

NixOS configuration

```
  environment.systemPackages = [
    pkgs.dua
  ];
```

#### NetBSD
Via `pkgin` on your NetBSD system.

```
pkgin install dua-cli
```

Or, building from source

```
cd /usr/pkgsrc/sysutils/dua-cli
make install
```

#### Windows

You will find pre-built binaries for Windows in the [releases section](https://github.com/Byron/dua-cli/releases).

#### x-cmd

[x-cmd](https://www.x-cmd.com/) is a **toolbox for Posix Shell**, offering a lightweight package manager built using shell and awk.
```sh
x env use dua
```
- Additionally, the [`x dua ...`](https://www.x-cmd.com/pkg/dua#dua) command is available, which automatically installs `dua` without affecting the environment, such as not modifying the `PATH` variable.

## Usage

```bash
# count the space used in the current working directory
dua
# count the space used in all directories that are not hidden
dua *
# learn about additional functionality
dua aggregate --help
```

### Interactive Mode

Launch into interactive mode with the `i` or `interactive` subcommand. Get help on keyboard
shortcuts with `?`.
Use this mode to explore, and/or to delete files and directories to release disk space.

Please note that great care has been taken to prevent accidental deletions due to a multi-stage
process, which makes this mode viable for exploration.

```bash
dua i
dua interactive
```

## Limitations

* Does not show symbolic links at all if no path is provided when invoking `dua`
  * in an effort to skip symbolic links, for now there are pruned and are not used as a root. Symbolic links will be shown if they
    are not a traversal root, but will not be followed.
* Interactive mode only looks good in dark terminals (see [this issue](https://github.com/Byron/dua-cli/issues/13))
* File names in main window are not truncated if too large. They are cut off on the right.
* There are plenty of examples in test fixtures which don't render correctly in interactive mode.
  This can be due to graphemes not interpreted correctly. With Chinese characters for instance,
  column sizes are not correctly computed, leading to certain columns not being shown.
  In other cases, the terminal gets things wrong - I use alacritty, and with certain characters it
  performs worse than, say iTerm3.
* In interactive mode, you will need about 60MB of memory for 1 million entries in the graph.
* In interactive mode, the maximum amount of files is limited to 2^32 - 1 entries.

## Similar Programs 

* **CLI:**
  * `du`
  * [`dust`](https://github.com/bootandy/dust)
  * [`dutree`](https://github.com/nachoparker/dutree)
  * [`pdu`](https://github.com/KSXGitHub/parallel-disk-usage)
* **TUI:**
  * [`ncdu`](https://dev.yorhel.nl/ncdu)
  * [`gdu`](https://github.com/dundee/gdu)
  * [`godu`](https://github.com/viktomas/godu)
* **GUI:**
  * [GNOME's Disk Usage Analyzer, a.k.a. `baobab`](https://wiki.gnome.org/action/show/Apps/DiskUsageAnalyzer)
  * [Filelight](https://apps.kde.org/filelight/)

fn glob_match(pattern: &str, text: &str, case_insensitive: bool) -> bool {
    let pat = if case_insensitive { pattern.to_lowercase() } else { pattern.to_string() };
    let txt = if case_insensitive { text.to_lowercase() } else { text.to_string() };
    fn matches(p: &[char], t: &[char]) -> bool {
        if p.is_empty() { return t.is_empty(); }
        if p[0] == '*' {
            for i in 0..=t.len() {
                if matches(&p[1..], &t[i..]) { return true; }
            }
            return false;
        } else if p[0] == '?' {
            if t.is_empty() { return false; }
            return matches(&p[1..], &t[1..]);
        } else {
            if t.is_empty() || p[0] != t[0] { return false; }
            return matches(&p[1..], &t[1..]);
        }
    }
    let pchars: Vec<char> = pat.chars().collect();
    let tchars: Vec<char> = txt.chars().collect();
    matches(&pchars, &tchars)
}

fn format_mtime(mtime: std::time::SystemTime) -> String {
    let datetime: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Local> = mtime.into();
    datetime.format("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S").to_string()
}

fn format_percent(size: u64, total: u64) -> String {
    if total == 0 {
        return format!("{:>7}", "0.0%");
    }
    let p = size as f64 / total as f64 * 100.0;
    format!("{:>7.1}%", p)
}

fn format_bar(size: u64, total: u64) -> String {
    if total == 0 {
        return "          ".to_string();
    }
    let p = size as f64 / total as f64;
    let filled_sub = (p * 80.0).round() as usize;
    let full = filled_sub / 8;
    let rem = filled_sub % 8;
    let partial_chars = ["", "▏", "▎", "▍", "▌", "▋", "▊", "▉"];
    let mut s = String::new();
    for _ in 0..full.min(10) {
        s.push('█');
    }
    if full < 10 && rem > 0 {
        s.push_str(partial_chars[rem]);
        let used = full + 1;
        for _ in used..10 {
            s.push(' ');
        }
    } else {
        for _ in full.min(10)..10 {
            s.push(' ');
        }
    }
    s
}

fn format_size_nopad(bytes: u64, format: Format) -> String {
    let s = format_size(bytes, format);
    s.trim_start().to_string()
}

fn sort_entries(entries: &mut Vec<EntryInfo>, mode: SortMode) {
    match mode {
        SortMode::SizeDesc => entries.sort_by(|a,b| b.size.cmp(&a.size).then_with(|| b.display.cmp(&a.display))),
        SortMode::SizeAsc => entries.sort_by(|a,b| a.size.cmp(&b.size).then_with(|| b.display.cmp(&a.display))),
        SortMode::MtimeDesc => entries.sort_by(|a,b| b.mtime.cmp(&a.mtime).then_with(|| b.display.cmp(&a.display))),
        SortMode::MtimeAsc => entries.sort_by(|a,b| a.mtime.cmp(&b.mtime).then_with(|| a.display.cmp(&b.display))),
        SortMode::CountDesc => entries.sort_by(|a,b| b.count.cmp(&a.count).then_with(|| b.display.cmp(&a.display))),
        SortMode::CountAsc => entries.sort_by(|a,b| a.count.cmp(&b.count).then_with(|| a.display.cmp(&b.display))),

        SortMode::NameDesc => entries.sort_by(|a,b| b.display.cmp(&a.display)),
    }
}

fn compute_dir_size_count(
    path: &Path,
    md: &fs::Metadata,
    apparent: bool,
    count_hard: bool,
    stay_on_fs: bool,
    ignore_set: &HashSet<String>,
    seen_files: &mut HashMap<(u64,u64), HashSet<String>>,
    seen_dirs: &mut HashSet<(u64,u64)>,
    root_device: Option<u64>,
    is_root: bool,
) -> (u64, u64) {
    let mut skip_children = false;
    if !is_root {
        if stay_on_fs {
            if let Some(rd) = root_device {
                if md.dev() != rd {
                    skip_children = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if !skip_children {
            if let Ok(canon) = fs::canonicalize(path) {
                if ignore_set.contains(&canon.to_string_lossy().to_string()) {
                    skip_children = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let key = (md.dev(), md.ino());
    let actual_self = if apparent { md.size() } else { md.blocks() * 512 };
    let mut self_size = actual_self;
    if !count_hard {
        if seen_dirs.contains(&key) {
            self_size = 0;
        } else {
            seen_dirs.insert(key);
        }
    }
    if skip_children {
        return (self_size, 1);
    }
    let read = match fs::read_dir(path) {
        Ok(rd) => rd,
        Err(_) => return (self_size, 1),
    };
    let mut children: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
    for ent in read {
        if let Ok(e) = ent {
            let p = e.path();
            if let Ok(md_child) = fs::symlink_metadata(&p) {
                if md_child.file_type().is_symlink() {
                    continue;
                }
                if stay_on_fs {
                    if let Some(rd) = root_device.or(Some(md.dev())) {
                        if md_child.dev() != rd {
                            continue;
                        }
                    }
                }
                children.push(p);
            }
        }
    }
    children.sort_by(|a,b| a.file_name().cmp(&b.file_name()));
    let child_root = root_device.or(Some(md.dev()));
    let mut total_size = self_size;
    let mut total_count = 1;
    for child in &children {
        if let Ok(md_child) = fs::symlink_metadata(child) {
            if md_child.is_dir() {
                let (sz, cnt) = compute_dir_size_count(child, &md_child, apparent, count_hard, stay_on_fs, ignore_set, seen_files, seen_dirs, child_root, false);
                total_size += sz;
                total_count += cnt;
            } else {
                let actual = if apparent { md_child.size() } else { md_child.blocks() * 512 };
                let mut sz = actual;
                if !count_hard && md_child.nlink() > 1 {
                    let k = (md_child.dev(), md_child.ino());
                    let canon = fs::canonicalize(child).map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string()).unwrap_or(child.to_string_lossy().to_string());
                    if let Some(set) = seen_files.get_mut(&k) {
                        if !set.contains(&canon) {
                            set.insert(canon);
                            sz = 0;
                        }
                    } else {
                        let mut set = HashSet::new();
                        set.insert(canon);
                        seen_files.insert(k, set);
                    }
                }
                total_size += sz;
                total_count += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    (total_size, total_count)
}

fn compute_entry_info(
    path: &Path,
    display: String,
    apparent: bool,
    count_hard: bool,
    stay_on_fs: bool,
    ignore_set: &HashSet<String>,
    seen_files: &mut HashMap<(u64,u64), HashSet<String>>,
    seen_dirs: &mut HashSet<(u64,u64)>,
    root_device: Option<u64>,
    is_root: bool,
) -> EntryInfo {
    let md_symlink = fs::symlink_metadata(path).unwrap();
    if md_symlink.file_type().is_symlink() {
        let target_md = fs::metadata(path).unwrap();
        if target_md.is_dir() {
            let (size, count) = compute_dir_size_count(path, &target_md, apparent, count_hard, stay_on_fs, ignore_set, seen_files, seen_dirs, root_device, is_root);
            let mtime = target_md.modified().unwrap_or(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH);
            return EntryInfo { path: path.to_path_buf(), display, is_dir: true, size, mtime, count };
        } else {
            let dev = md_symlink.dev();
            let ino = md_symlink.ino();
            let actual_size = if apparent { md_symlink.size() } else { md_symlink.blocks() * 512 };
            let mut size = actual_size;
            if !count_hard && md_symlink.nlink() > 1 {
                let key = (dev, ino);
                let canon = fs::canonicalize(path).map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string()).unwrap_or(path.to_string_lossy().to_string());
                if let Some(set) = seen_files.get_mut(&key) {
                    if !set.contains(&canon) {
                        set.insert(canon);
                        size = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    let mut set = HashSet::new();
                    set.insert(canon);
                    seen_files.insert(key, set);
                }
            }
            let mtime = md_symlink.modified().unwrap_or(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH);
            return EntryInfo { path: path.to_path_buf(), display, is_dir: false, size, mtime, count: 1 };
        }
    } else if md_symlink.is_dir() {
        let (size, count) = compute_dir_size_count(path, &md_symlink, apparent, count_hard, stay_on_fs, ignore_set, seen_files, seen_dirs, root_device, is_root);
        let mtime = md_symlink.modified().unwrap_or(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH);
        return EntryInfo { path: path.to_path_buf(), display, is_dir: true, size, mtime, count };
    } else {
        let dev = md_symlink.dev();
        let ino = md_symlink.ino();
        let actual_size = if apparent { md_symlink.size() } else { md_symlink.blocks() * 512 };
        let mut size = actual_size;
        if !count_hard && md_symlink.nlink() > 1 {
            let key = (dev, ino);
            let canon = fs::canonicalize(path).map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string()).unwrap_or(path.to_string_lossy().to_string());
            if let Some(set) = seen_files.get_mut(&key) {
                if !set.contains(&canon) {
                    set.insert(canon);
                    size = 0;
                }
            } else {
                let mut set = HashSet::new();
                set.insert(canon);
                seen_files.insert(key, set);
            }
        }
        let mtime = md_symlink.modified().unwrap_or(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH);
        return EntryInfo { path: path.to_path_buf(), display, is_dir: false, size, mtime, count: 1 };
    }
}

fn load_entries(
    current_path: &Path,
    is_multi: bool,
    inputs: &Vec<String>,
    apparent: bool,
    count_hard: bool,
    stay_on_fs: bool,
    ignore_set: &HashSet<String>,
) -> (Vec<EntryInfo>, u64) {
    let mut seen_files: HashMap<(u64,u64), HashSet<String>> = HashMap::new();
    let mut seen_dirs: HashSet<(u64,u64)> = HashSet::new();
    let mut entries: Vec<EntryInfo> = Vec::new();
    if is_multi {
        for inp in inputs {
            let p = PathBuf::from(inp);
            let md_symlink = match fs::symlink_metadata(&p) {
                Ok(m) => m,
                Err(_) => continue,
            };
            let is_symlink = md_symlink.file_type().is_symlink();
            let is_dir = if is_symlink {
                match fs::metadata(&p) {
                    Ok(tm) => tm.is_dir(),
                    Err(_) => continue,
                }
            } else {
                md_symlink.is_dir()
            };
            let abs_path = fs::canonicalize(&p).unwrap_or(p.clone());
            let root_dev = if is_dir {
                fs::metadata(&p).map(|m| m.dev()).ok()
            } else {
                None
            };
            let mut info = compute_entry_info(&p, inp.clone(), apparent, count_hard, stay_on_fs, ignore_set, &mut seen_files, &mut seen_dirs, root_dev, true);
            info.path = abs_path;
            info.is_dir = is_dir;
            entries.push(info);
        }
    } else {
        let read = match fs::read_dir(current_path) {
            Ok(rd) => rd,
            Err(_) => return (vec![], 0),
        };
        let mut children: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
        for ent in read {
            if let Ok(e) = ent {
                let p = e.path();
                if let Ok(md) = fs::symlink_metadata(&p) {
                    if md.file_type().is_symlink() {
                        continue;
                    }
                    children.push(p);
                }
            }
        }
        children.sort_by(|a,b| a.file_name().cmp(&b.file_name()));
        let root_dev = fs::metadata(current_path).map(|m| m.dev()).ok();
        for child in &children {
            let display = child.file_name().map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string()).unwrap_or(child.to_string_lossy().to_string());
            let info = compute_entry_info(child, display, apparent, count_hard, stay_on_fs, ignore_set, &mut seen_files, &mut seen_dirs, root_dev, false);
            entries.push(info);
        }
    }
    let total_desc: u64 = entries.iter().map(|e| e.count).sum();
    (entries, total_desc)
}

pub fn run(
    input: Vec<String>,
    format: Format,
    apparent: bool,
    count_hard: bool,
    stay_on_fs: bool,
    _ignore_raw: Vec<String>,
    canonicalized_ignore: Vec<String>,
    _log: Option<fs::File>,
) {
    use crossterm::{terminal::{enable_raw_mode, disable_raw_mode, size, EnterAlternateScreen, LeaveAlternateScreen}, execute, cursor::Hide, cursor::Show, event::{read, Event, KeyCode, KeyModifiers}};
    use std::io::{stdout, Write};

    let ignore_set: HashSet<String> = canonicalized_ignore.into_iter().collect();
    let cwd_abs = fs::canonicalize(".").unwrap_or(PathBuf::from("."));

    let (mut current_path, mut is_multi_view, mut initial_inputs) = if input.is_empty() {
        (cwd_abs.clone(), false, vec![])
    } else if input.len() == 1 {
        let p = PathBuf::from(&input[0]);
        let is_dir = match fs::symlink_metadata(&p) {
            Ok(md) => {
                if md.file_type().is_symlink() {
                    fs::metadata(&p).map(|m| m.is_dir()).unwrap_or(false)
                } else {
                    md.is_dir()
                }
            }
            Err(_) => false,
        };
        if is_dir {
            let canon = fs::canonicalize(&p).unwrap_or(p.clone());
            (canon, false, vec![])
        } else {
            (cwd_abs.clone(), true, input.clone())
        }
    } else {
        (cwd_abs.clone(), true, input.clone())
    };

    let mut sort_mode = SortMode::SizeDesc;
    let mut show_mtime = false;
    let mut show_count = false;
    #[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
    enum BarMode { PercentAndBar, PercentOnly, BarOnly, BarOnlyWide }
    let mut bar_mode = BarMode::PercentAndBar;
    let mut selected: usize = 0;
    let mut scroll_offset: usize = 0;
    let mut show_help = false;

    let mut history: Vec<(PathBuf, bool, Vec<String>)> = Vec::new();
    let start_time = std::time::Instant::now();
    let (mut entries_unfiltered, _) = load_entries(&current_path, is_multi_view, &initial_inputs, apparent, count_hard, stay_on_fs, &ignore_set);
    sort_entries(&mut entries_unfiltered, sort_mode);
    let mut global_total_size: u64 = entries_unfiltered.iter().map(|e| e.size).sum();
    let mut global_entries_count: u64 = entries_unfiltered.iter().map(|e| e.count).sum();

    enable_raw_mode().unwrap();
    let mut out = stdout();
    execute!(out, EnterAlternateScreen, Hide).unwrap();

    loop {
        let visible_entries = entries_unfiltered.clone();
        let title_visible = visible_entries.len();
        let title_total: u64 = visible_entries.iter().map(|e| e.count).sum();
        let title_size: u64 = visible_entries.iter().map(|e| e.size).sum();

        if visible_entries.is_empty() {
            selected = 0;
            scroll_offset = 0;
        } else if selected >= visible_entries.len() {
            selected = visible_entries.len() - 1;
        }

        let (term_w, term_h) = size().unwrap_or((100, 30));
        let term_w = term_w as usize;
        let term_h = term_h as usize;
        let list_height = term_h.saturating_sub(4);
        if !visible_entries.is_empty() {
            if selected < scroll_offset {
                scroll_offset = selected;
            } else if selected >= scroll_offset + list_height {
                scroll_offset = selected - list_height + 1;
            }
        }

        // Render
        let mut screen = String::new();
        screen.push_str("\x1b[?25l\x1b[1;1H\x1b[2J");
        // Top bar
        {
            let mut top = String::new();
            top.push_str("\x1b[1m\x1b[38;5;0m\x1b[48;5;15m D\x1b[22misk \x1b[1mU\x1b[22msage \x1b[1mA\x1b[22mnalyzer v2.32.2    \x1b[4m(press \x1b[1m?\x1b[22m for help)\x1b[24m");
            let visible_len = 50;
            if term_w > visible_len {
                for _ in visible_len..term_w {
                    top.push(' ');
                }
            }
            top.push_str("\x1b[39m\x1b[49m\x1b[0m");
            screen.push_str("\x1b[1;1H");
            screen.push_str(&top);
        }
        // Border top
        {
            let path_display = if history.is_empty() {
                current_path.to_string_lossy().to_string()
            } else {
                current_path.file_name().map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().to_string()).unwrap_or(current_path.to_string_lossy().to_string())
            };
            let size_str = format_size_nopad(title_size, format);
            let title_inner = format!("{} ({} visible, {} total, {})", path_display, title_visible, title_total, size_str);
            let hints = " . = o|.. = u ── ⇊ = Ctrl+d|↓ = j|⇈ = Ctrl+u|↑ = k ";
            let show_hints = term_w >= 100;
            let left = format!("┌ {} ", title_inner);
            let right = if show_hints { format!("{}┐", hints) } else { format!("┐") };
            let left_len = left.chars().count();
            let right_len = right.chars().count();
            let mut line2 = left;
            if term_w > left_len + right_len {
                for _ in 0..(term_w - left_len - right_len) {
                    line2.push('─');
                }
            }
            line2.push_str(&right);
            let chars: Vec<char> = line2.chars().collect();
            if chars.len() > term_w {
                line2 = chars[..term_w].iter().collect();
                let mut v: Vec<char> = line2.chars().collect();
                if !v.is_empty() {
                    v[v.len()-1] = '┐';
                    line2 = v.iter().collect();
                }
            }
            screen.push_str("\x1b[2;1H\x1b[1m");
            screen.push_str(&line2);
            screen.push_str("\x1b[22m");
        }
        // List
        for i in 0..list_height {
